# Periodic Burst averaged player buff

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Periodic Burst, Spiral Strike

## Notes / caveats / open questions

SS13 canonical data grants 20.5% increased Attack and Cast Speed for 2 seconds every 6 seconds. Owner requested a steady-use average and confirmed the buff affects all skills on 2026-10-04. The model assumes the supported Mobility skill is used at each opportunity. No in-game numerical comparison is recorded. Spiral Strike damage remains unmodeled because its hit count is unspecified.

## Implementation (engine model)

resolve_standard_supports averages the canonical Attack and Cast Speed increase by buff duration / interval, capped at full uptime. Periodic Burst requires a Mobility host and grants both speed contributions globally. Other support contributions retain slot-local routing.
